title: Long-read (ONT/PacBio) simulated fusion track
context: Backlog (unscheduled) extension for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. Adds a long-read (ONT/PacBio) simulated fusion track once a long-read simulator and caller adapters are available. All data is simulated and CC-licensed per the open-data guardrail; this expands the benchmark's modality coverage beyond short-read RNA-seq. Scheduling depends on simulator/adapter availability.
objective: Generate a long-read (ONT/PacBio) simulated fusion track with ground-truth manifests, conforming to the canonical data model, once a long-read simulator and caller adapters exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Long-read simulated cases generated with per-case ground-truth manifests conforming to schema-003; license CC-BY-4.0/CC0; provenance recorded.
Documents the long-read simulator used and its realism assumptions/limits.
output: data/sim/longread-track/ — simulated ONT/PacBio fusion cases + ground-truth manifests.
